services.desc: This intimate One Bedroom Luxury Cabin is exclusively for 2 people and is perfect for a romantic getaway in the mountains! Birchwood features a hot tub on the screened in porch, perfect for relaxing while viewing nature at its best! It features the following amenities: Queen Bedroom Bathroom with Shower Fully-Equipped Kitchen Electric Fireplace Cable TV / Wi-Fi Screened-in Porch with Hot Tub Air Conditioning / Electric Heat Outside Fire Ring & Picnic Table Guests must provide linens and towels. services.name: Seasonal Campsites
services.desc: Tired of towing your RV? Frustrated with not being able to get holiday reservations? Park your RV, set it up once, and use it throughout the entire year! At Ole Mink Farm, you will find spacious seasonal campsites … seasonal vacation getaways that include winter storage on your site. No Storage Fees! - No Towing Worries! - No Reservation Hassles! (For recreational purposes only. Sorry, no month-to-month rentals.) services.name: Rental Hall
services.desc: Welcome to Reflection Hall … your meeting space in the mountains, a tranquil alternative for your business meeting or management retreat! Whether you are looking to hold a business meeting or to host a family get-together, consider Ole Mink Farm for your next gathering! Reflection Hall provides the splendor of the outdoors with the conveniences of a larger facility. Reflection Hall has a large meeting space and a separate prep kitchen area. The hall may be set up with table seating or theater style seating. For your comfort, central air and heat is available in the facility. blurb: Wonderful memories await you at Ole Mink Farm Recreation Resort. For over sixty years, the Irons Family has been hosting getaways for families and friends to make memories that last a lifetime. We invite you to experience “Seclusion so close to home” at our beautiful resort. Offering Seasonal Campsites as well as Luxury Log Cabins and Camping Cabins, there is something for everyone!
